description: This file defines a mock implementation of a language model API, including methods for chat completion, streaming, reranking, and listing models, primarily used for testing purposes.

classes.name: MockApi
classes.description: A mock implementation of the BaseLlmApi interface for testing language model interactions.

methods.name: chatCompletionNonStream
methods.description: Simulates a non-streaming chat completion response with a delay.

methods.name: chatCompletionStream
methods.description: Streams chat completion chunks with simulated delays.

methods.name: completionNonStream
methods.description: Provides a mock non-streaming completion response.

methods.name: completionStream
methods.description: Streams completion chunks with simulated delays.

methods.name: fimStream
methods.description: Streams chunks for FIM (possibly 'Fine-tuned Inference Model') with delays.

methods.name: rerank
methods.description: Method not implemented; intended for reranking responses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of mock models.
